hooks.command: cd "{{VIBEOS_ROOT}}" && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then f="{{VIBEOS_ROOT}}/.git/vibeos-nudge-ts"; now=$(date +%s); last=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $((now-last)) -gt 3600 ]; then echo "$now" > "$f"; echo '{"systemMessage":"VibeOS: you have uncommitted changes. When you wrap up, run /vcos-session-close so the team captures what it learned."}'; fi; fi; exit 0
